about: Onigiri is a MMORPG Action RPG where you can use various types of weapons to combat monsters.

In a fantastic world that mixes Japanese history, legends, folklore and fairytales, the story will take you and your companions through an exciting journey. In addition to the function Party Play by multiple players, you can choose one of your 8 companions to take into battles and fight against fierce monsters.
summary: Onigiri is a MMORPG Action RPG where you can use various types of weapons to combat monsters.
